name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for ShotShot
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

### Problem / use case

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? A concrete workflow
is more useful than a solution sketch.

### Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

### Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, including workarounds you use today.

### Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or links to similar behavior in other tools.

---

> ℹ️ ShotShot is local-first and BYOK: proposals that require a hosted backend
> or accounts are out of scope by design.
